mints.t: Inventory loss logged to a tamper-proof ledger
mints.say: A store's truth lives where no one can edit it.
mints.note: Each SKU a document; index by storeId + timestamp.
mints.why: Retail shrink shifts to fraud; truth needs anchors.

mints.t: Tiny treasury that pays on a heartbeat
mints.say: Money that moves on time teaches trust.
mints.note: Contract holds credits; superblock trigger releases to approved identities.
mints.why: Builders need predictable, automated micro-grant flows.

mints.t: AI agents earn and spend Dash autonomously
mints.say: Machines that hold keys learn accountability.
mints.note: Agent identity + two human keys guard the treasury.
mints.why: AI agents need on-chain purses with oversight.

mints.t: DPNS names that expire and renew like tides
mints.say: Identity is a lease, not a deed.
mints.note: DPNS document with $createdAt; query filters out expired.

mints.t: Notarize any document with a ChainLock proof
mints.say: Proof of existence, anchored to global consensus.
mints.note: Hash document → embed in OP_RETURN → wait for ChainLock.
mints.why: Legal and compliance need immutable timestamps.

mints.t: Shared credit balance for a team's Platform ops
mints.say: Fuel held in common builds faster.
mints.note: One identity holds credits; others sign STs as authorized keys.
mints.why: Teams waste time topping up individual identities.

mints.t: Live dashboard of any Platform contract's documents
mints.say: Seeing the network think is its own lesson.
mints.note: DAPI subscribeToDocuments + prove query against Drive root.
mints.why: Builders debug by watching state transitions live.

mints.t: Send a payment through a CoinJoin route
mints.say: Privacy is a path, not a place.
mints.note: Wallet SDK initiates CoinJoin; recipient address is the last hop.
mints.why: Regulatory clarity makes privacy tools operational.
